reasons.text: Electricity bought is only 0.38x the minimum needed for the tonnes claimed (114 kWh/t against at least 300)
Sold products equal only 19% of the output expected from the tonnes claimed
In 100% of months, product sales fall far short of the claimed input
In 100% of billed months the units consumed cannot support the tonnes claimed
Declared capacity of 27,850 t/yr needs about 1.8x the power the plant is connected for
77% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.83x the cost floor)

model_signals.label: months with output far below input

inspection_checklist: Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Reconcile product sales with processed tonnes; contact the product buyers listed and verify that they received the material.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
